TA0065.title: Robot & Embodied Intelligence Attacker
TA0065.description: An attacker specialized against robot and embodied-intelligence systems, with capabilities in VLA model adversarial attacks, teleoperation channel hijacking, ROS/DDS middleware vulnerability exploitation, and robot hardware debug-interface attacks, motivated by espionage, extortion, physical sabotage, ideological attacks, and nation-state operations. Such attackers exploit embodied-intelligence-unique attack surfaces like Unitree UniPwn-style BLE command injection, RoboPAIR-style VLA jailbreaks, Raven II-style teleoperation hijacking, and FastDDS-style middleware vulnerabilities to make humanoid robots, surgical robots, and autonomous-driving systems perform unintended physical actions or be fully taken over. Unlike TA0049 (industrial & V2X attacker, focused on OT/V2X protocols) and TA0048 (IoT botnet operator, focused on device DDoS), This attacker focuses on the model-layer and physical-world attack surfaces unique to embodied intelligence, where consequences translate directly into physical harm or physical-world destruction.
